- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shibuya is known for its famous scramble crossing, vibrant area, shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Asakusa is famous for Senso-ji Temple and offers a traditional Japanese atmosphere.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Roppongi is an upscale area known for luxury hotels and easy access to Tokyo Tower.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ikebukuro is a bustling commercial district with shopping and dining options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ueno is a cultural hub with museums and parks, close to the Tsukiji Fish Market (outer market).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] $64 per night is a relatively good price for a 7-night stay in Tokyo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested questions to consider when researching Airbnb: location convenience, included amenities, additional fees, and cancellation policy.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of staying in Shibuya include convenience, access to public transport, nightlife, and shopping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of staying in Shibuya include noise and crowds, higher prices, and limited Airbnb options.
